title_o: Knowing Who You Are and Adding to It

replications.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
replications.quote: We next examined the primary hypothesis that the manipulation influenced participants’ spontaneous self-expansion. A between-subjects analysis of covariance revealed a non- significant effect of condition on self-ratings of the target attribute participants generated at the beginning of the study after viewing the dating profile controlling for initial self- ratings, F(2, 138) = 0.9377, p = .394, partial 𝜂2 = 0.0134.
